name: osamah-vids-ai
description: Osamah vids ai — desktop AI video production studio (opencode agent + Playwright capture + ffmpeg)

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 tcp:8799 && npm run start --workspace @osamah/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @osamah/core && npm run build --workspace @osamah/render-engine && npm run build --workspace @osamah/web && npm run build --workspace @osamah/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @osamah/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
